english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the central character in a story or the lead performer, not a leading contest competitor.
This is the all-purpose choice for the main role or the actor playing it in a film, play, or story.
Use 主角 when “hero” means the protagonist of a fictional work, regardless of whether that character is morally heroic.

examples.english: A newcomer plays the protagonist in this film.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲嘅主角由一位新人擔任。
